title: The uncle at the pond
logline: Gully's uncle at the pond's edge on a break, from behind, a thermos, the logs, the stack. Twenty-eight years before the private page draws him he was a back at a pond. The sequence says so.

panels.composition: A broad man in a canvas jacket from behind sitting on a log at a millpond's edge with a thermos, floating logs, the mill's wall and stack, black spotting on the water.
